name: Silver Bow Mining Corp.
summary: Silver Bow Mining Corp. (SBMT) specializes in the acquisition, exploration, and development of mineral-rich properties throughout the United States. The company currently operates its flagship Rainbow Block project, which is strategically located near Butte, Montana. This particular site is known for yielding valuable metals such as silver, zinc, gold, and lead. Silver Bow Mining Corp. was established on August 31, 2020, and its corporate headquarters are also situated in Butte, Montana.
